name: adhd-ste100-eli5
description: An output style that makes Claude Code answers cheap to read and cheap to act on. Three non-overlapping layers: message shape from ADHD support practice (action first, numbered steps, state restated every turn), sentence mechanics from the ASD-STE100 controlled-English standard (one instruction per sentence, capped length, active voice), and word choice from ELI5 (plainest word, jargon explained in the same breath). Language-neutral — it follows whatever language you write in.
